text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait's Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah condemns Damascus bus bombing.
- Constitutional court rejects cases challenging a law that governs the repayment of $20 in private sector bad debts owed to the state.
- Parliamentarian wants government held accountable if it fails to implement its agenda.
- Share index up, value and volume of traded shares down.
- Workers union concerned about jobs of workers at the Shuwaikh Port where the state plans to create a free trade zone under the management of a private sector firm.
- Islamist parliamentarian says the government turned hotels into night clubs, wants ban on concerts.
- MPs table bill to give women the right to vote and to run for parliament seats.
